Callout.Name: VIP Evacuation
Callout.Message: Protective detail requesting an evacuation route.
Callout.Advisory: Principal in a vehicle, route not yet clear.

Script.Line: The route has to be clear before the convoy moves.
I need a left turn and a clear run to the motorway.
If the route is not clear the convoy does not move. That is the whole of it.

Lines.Approach: They need the route clear before they move. It is a two-minute job if the road is empty.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
